ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Clean Science and Technology Limited's 23rd Annual General Meeting successfully approved all seven ordinary resolutions with overwhelming shareholder support, including the adoption of FY2026 financial statements, a total dividend of Rs. 6 per equity share, and key director appointments. The near-unanimous votes across promoter and institutional categories reflect strong confidence in the company's governance and proposed actions. No material red flags were observed in the voting outcomes or agenda.
